rubric: A test that flips on unchanged code: flaky.

criteria.reason: a test fails and passes on its own, with no change to the code it covers

reading.why: The same test passed and failed on the same commit: it flips with no change to the code it covers.

ruledOut.question: reason
ruledOut.label: plan_wrong
ruledOut.why: The test flips on unchanged code. It is not: the approved plan cannot be built as written: a step names something that does not exist, or the steps contradict each other or the code.

ruledOut.question: reason
ruledOut.label: env_broken
ruledOut.why: The test flips on unchanged code. It is not: the environment is at fault: a service, a tool, a credential, the network or the container, not the change.

ruledOut.question: reason
ruledOut.label: too_complex
ruledOut.why: The test flips on unchanged code. It is not: the change is bigger or harder than the plan allowed for, and the run ran out of room before it finished.

ruledOut.question: reason
ruledOut.label: undeclared_scope
ruledOut.why: The test flips on unchanged code. It is not: the work needs files or changes the plan does not name.

ruledOut.question: reason
ruledOut.label: other
ruledOut.why: The test flips on unchanged code. It is not: none of these fits, or the evidence does not say.
